description:
Wanna know how to maximize the use of your SunLife Website? Here's a good help for all our Sun Life Clients as you can access your policy both online and via app.

Here, I demonstrate how to use the Sun Life app and through this app, you can have the access of your life insurance policy and mutual funds status. 

Visit the www.sunlife.com.ph and sign in to have access of your account.

And if you wish to have a dibs of this special service from Sun Life, you can send me a message and let me help you with your financial journey:

ailyn.b.caringal@sunife.com.ph
0918 765 6590
